answer_1.quote: Several experiments on MuST-C (Di Gangi et al., 2019) English-German and English-French speech-to-text translation tasks with our proposed approach show clear improvements of latency-quality trade-offs over the state-of-the-art MMA models.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of the models on both the latency and quality aspects. We use Average Lagging(AL) as our latency metric and case-sensitive detokenized SacreBLEU to measure the translation quality.
